name: Facets Content type or Other
description: A Facets facet that displays content types with an 'Other' catch-all value.
project_description:
The Facets Content type or Other module provides a way to index content types and group some into an "Other" category. The content type labels can be overridden in the configuration.

 Example:

 * Article

* Basic page

* Other

 Configuration 
 1. Configure the Content type or Other settings at `/admin/config/search/facets-content-type-or-other`.

2. In your Search index, go to Fields and add a "Content type or other" field.

3. Go to Facets and add a Facet for Content type or other.

4. Under "Facet sorting", select "Content type or Other - Sort order" and make sure that all other sorting options are deselected.

5. Re-index all content.
